sources.title: Meta cuts 8,000 jobs in sweeping global layoffs
sources.description: Meta cancels hiring plans for 6,000 roles amid ongoing layoffs and a pivot to artificial intelligence development.

sources.title: Meta, Intuit lay announce thousands of layoffs
sources.description: The Bay Area tech sector faced a fresh wave of disruption Wednesday as Meta and Mountain View-based software company, Intuit, announced thousands of layoffs, adding to a growing list of major companies slashing their workforces amid rapid shifts in the industry.

sources.title: Meta's Bay Area layoffs affect roughly 200 workers as company pours billions into AI infrastructure
sources.description: Meta is cutting approximately 200 jobs in the San Francisco Bay Area as the company restructures teams and invests heavily in AI infrastructure.

sources.title: Meta slashes roughly 700 jobs; layoffs hit multiple teams across the company
sources.description: The latest job cuts at Meta hit areas like Reality Labs and social media teams as the company seeks greater cost control amid heavy spending on AI infrastructure.

sources.title: Meta's VR layoffs, studio closures underscore Zuckerberg's massive pivot to AI
sources.description: Meta began laying off employees in its Reality Labs division focused on virtual reality and shut down several VR studios as it pushes resources towards AI.

sources.title: Meta To Cut 10% Of Reality Labs As Metaverse Interest Fades
sources.description: The division employs roughly 15,000 and has burned more than $60 billion since 2020, with headset and virtual network teams hit hardest, per the NYT.

sources.title: Meta lays off 600 employees in artificial intelligence unit
sources.description: Meta Platforms is cutting roughly 600 artificial intelligence jobs.

sources.title: Meta to cut 5% of workforce targeting 'lowest performers'
sources.description: Summary: Meta is planning to cut approximately 5% of its workforce, or about 3,600 positions, in February. The cuts will be performance-based to “move out lowest performers faster” as it cited 2025 will be “an intense year.”

sources.title: Meta to layoff around 3,600 in 'performance-based cuts'
sources.description: The layoffs will remove 5 percent of Meta's workforce as an effort to 'move out low performers faster' in preparation for 'an intense year,' said CEO Mark Zuckerberg.

sources.title: Facebook-parent Meta plans to lay off another 10,000 employees
sources.description: Facebook's parent company Meta plans to lay off another 10,000 workers, marking the second round of significant job cuts announced by the tech giant in four months.

sources.title: Meta laying off more than 11,000 employees: Read Zuckerberg's letter announcing the cuts
sources.description: Meta is laying off 13% of its staff, or more than 11,000 employees, CEO Mark Zuckerberg told employees on Wednesday.
